sentences.text: For challenging the action of Police Authorities for repeatedly Patna High Court CR.
WJC No.2533 of 2024(2) dt.04-08-2025 harassing, man handling and threatening the old aged Petitioner no.01 and Petitioner no.2.
C.CT.V footage of the entire incident is saved and the Petitioner can produce the same in pen drive if and when required.

For quashing of FIR registered against the Petitioner no.1 and Petitioner no.2 registered at Kadamkuan P.S case no. 703/2024 under sections 85, 126(2), 115(2), 76,
324(6) and 351(3) of the BNS.
[498A, 341, 323, 354B, 440 and 506 of the IPC respectively] and all subsequent proceeding arising there from.
3. Kadamkuan P.S. Case No.876 of 2024 has been registered on the complaint of the petitioner.
4. In these circumstances, this application is disposed of with direction to the Police to conclude the investigation within three months after properly investigating the case.

(Sandeep Kumar, J) anand/-
